### The Wisdom of Listening
Author: Burk Parsons
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wisdom-of-listening
Passage: Genesis 49:1-2
Points:
- True wisdom develops from cultivating the discipline of listening to God and seasoned spiritual mentors.
- Pastors and leaders earn the right to speak when they attentively listen to God's Word and their congregations.
- In Scripture, listening is an imperative command to perceive, take to heart, and heed instruction.
- Jacob's dying exhortation to his sons urges God's people to learn from the lessons of a patriarch shaped by God.

### Judah's Scepter
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judahs-scepter
Passage: Genesis 49:8-12
Points:
- Judah inherited the primary blessing after his older brothers forfeited it through dishonorable conduct.
- A spirit of repentance and willingness to sacrifice himself for Benjamin marked Judah's growth into leadership.
- Jacob's prophecy anticipates the rule of the Davidic dynasty and extraordinary future abundance.
- The eternal scepter finds its ultimate fulfillment in Jesus Christ, the Lion of Judah.
- Humility and self-sacrifice remain the only biblical path to true exaltation.

### Bible Pathways - Jan. 17, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-jan-17-2009-11598243.html
Passage: Genesis 49:9-10
Points:
- Jacob's deathbed blessing designates Judah to carry forward the covenant and the promise of the Messiah.
- The title Shiloh portrays the coming Messiah as the righteous King and Peacemaker.
- Joseph's suffering at the hands of hostile archers was redeemed through the Lord's providential care.
- Confidence in God's sovereignty over every circumstance empowers believers to release bitterness and love their enemies.
